description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in, and a verified referrer account. Gives a request the signed-in referrer claimed back to the open pool for every referrer at the company. Use it when a colleague could refer instead; use decline_referral_request when the candidate is not a fit.
name: release_referral_request

action.description: The action that was applied: claim, release, referred, decline or request_changes.

status_label.description: The new status as techjobs.vn shows it (Vietnamese).

title: Release a claimed referral request
